title: Blood Sugar and Carpal Tunnel
excerpt: For 7 years, I carefully practiced the living-foods program but, during the last year, I succumbed to the “sugar bug”.
content:
For 7 years, I carefully practiced the living-foods program but, during the last year, I succumbed to the “sugar bug”. In November of 2002, I also took a perilous fall that totally-contorted my body and broke my left hand, which put me out of work as a professional violinist and production knitter. I decided to assist my healing with wheatgrass and green drink with lots of fresh LifeGive live algae. My intention was to play viola instead of violin in my string quartet for a friend’s wedding. My goal was accomplished, and my hand-therapists were amazed at the results. It is truly wondrous when you stick to the foods that God has provided for us to ingest.

My friend, Linda, then became ill, and no one was able to diagnose her dilemma. We had talked for several years about going to Hippocrates together, so we began our stay in july of 2003. As I write this, we are still here, in our second week, and Linda is stronger, and I have had miraculous results with my left hand. After eight months, I am once again able to play the violin; however, when I came, I told Anna Maria, who is also a wonderful violinist, about my incomplete range of motion. She gave me a rigorous regimen of supplements, electromagnetic therapies, garlic and apples, wheatgrass hand-application and of course, green drinks. I also availed myself of the spa services, utilizing the neuromuscular massage aptly administered by Tom, which has already given not only my hand more movement but also a general body-alignment. I anticipate full use of my hand by the end of my stay.

I thank the Lord continually for providing me with such wonderful opportunities to heal. They body is truly “fearfully and wonderfully made”. Thanks to all who have helped in my challenging, rewarding and continuing journey to health.
